plan.plain_statement: Determine whether the reported widespread expression differences between C10 and C15 remain supported when batch effects and statistical uncertainty are handled in the test model.

claims.estimand: Mean squared C10-minus-C15 condition effect over all measured probe features on the quantile-normalised log2 scale, conditional on batch and the other condition levels; estimated with subtraction of the sampling-variance contribution. This is an exploratory matrix-join estimand, not a registered scalar-column regression estimand.
claims.unit: Independent sample expression profile; probes are correlated outcomes, not independent replicates
claims.test: Exploratory restricted wild-bootstrap test of no C10-minus-C15 expression effect, with a sample-level bootstrap standard error and confidence interval for the mean squared effect

sharedKnobs.scope: Plan only, based on TASK.md, the embedded public contract and the mounted schema. No expression values, sample-level records, joint summaries or prior numerical results have been inspected. The scientific claim is exploratory because the registered kernel cannot represent its matrix join or multivariate estimand. Do not relabel it as data-integrity, claim registered certification, or fabricate an ordinary numerical outcome column.

source_metadata.expression_scale: Already log2; do not log-transform again
source_metadata.order: Keyed permutations; order has no biological meaning
source_metadata.contract_availability: DATA-CONTRACT.json is embedded metadata, not a mounted input file. Freeze these required facts under code at implementation time.

sharedKnobs.join: The claim's outcome field sample is the existing sample-sheet column used to locate the multivariate expression response, not a numeric outcome to regress. Match each expression column header other than feature to exactly one A-samples.tsv sample value and explicitly reorder metadata to the expression columns. Each feature row defines one response vector across those samples. Retain feature identifiers verbatim. Decode JSON-encoded original, canonical and target registry cells before using aliases; enforce one-to-one mapping and do not treat identifier spellings as biological information. The matrix join and its unsupported response shape must be disclosed in primary.json.

integrity.checks: Verify shapes, unique feature IDs, unique expression headers and sample-sheet IDs, exact header-to-sample set equality, finite numeric cells, complete batch/condition fields, and registry coverage. Compute the full batch-by-condition table, target-condition batch lists, design ranks, residual degrees of freedom and contrast estimability. Test raw expression columns for exact equality; inspect pairwise distances/correlations and profiles before and after normalisation. Record zero-variance rows and any numerical fitting exclusions.
integrity.duplicated_units: List every supplied sample identifier belonging to an identity group established by duplicate sample IDs, decoded alias identity, or exactly identical complete raw expression vectors. High correlation or equality created only by normalisation is insufficient to establish duplicate biological units. Near-duplicate profiles are diagnostic flags only. Without subject identifiers, do not claim that hidden biological overlap has been excluded.
integrity.unit_handling: The prior rerun retains every supplied sample. For the preferred analysis, collapse confirmed duplicate profiles with concordant batch and condition into one equally weighted profile using their already-normalised values. If identity is confirmed but annotations conflict, exclude the whole conflicting identity group from the preferred fit and report the ambiguity. Do not relabel conditions from clustering. Do not remove outliers solely for large effects, high influence or PCA separation.
integrity.outliers: Use sample distributions, correlations, PCA and leave-one-sample influence as diagnostics. Such diagnostics do not prove mislabelling or justify the mislabelled-samples cause. Record unusual profiles in other_problems with uncertainty. No automatic expression-based sample filtering.
integrity.fatal_checks: Never manufacture results for broken joins, unreadable cells or a non-estimable contrast. Report the computational limitation explicitly. Rank deficiency alone is not fatal if the contrast is estimable in a reduced full-rank parameterisation.

sharedKnobs.normalisation: Quantile-normalise the entire 46547-by-105 matrix once, before any restriction or duplicate collapse. Use limma normalizeQuantiles semantics: average the sorted columns rank by rank and map tied observations using their average ranks with linear interpolation of the target quantiles. Store this single matrix and reuse it for all subsequent analyses. No feature filtering, log transformation or re-normalisation on a subset.

prior_pipeline.batch_adjustment: Implement standard parametric ComBat location-and-scale adjustment with every sample and every condition: batch indicators plus a full-rank protected condition design, no reference batch, par.prior TRUE, mean.only FALSE. Fit batch/condition coefficients, batch-size-weighted grand mean and gene-wise pooled residual variance with denominator total sample number; standardise, estimate batch gamma and delta, estimate normal gamma and inverse-gamma delta hyperparameters across features, and iterate their posterior updates to relative tolerance 1e-4 with a hard cap of 10000 iterations. Reverse standardisation and restore the protected condition contribution. Preserve and report standard ComBat zero-within-batch-variance handling. Do not silently use nonparametric or mean-only adjustment, target-only samples, or condition-blind ComBat.
prior_pipeline.test: Fit one coefficient for each condition to the adjusted full matrix, contrast C10 minus C15, and use limma-equivalent default eBayes moderated two-sided t tests: trend FALSE, robust FALSE, ordinary residual variances, fitFDist/squeezeVar prior and limma total-df cap. No batch term in this prior test. Compute BH adjustment over the entire probe family, count adjusted p strictly below 0.05, and rank ten distinct features by raw contrast p ascending. Resolve exact p ties by feature identifier, never row order.
prior_pipeline.numeric_implementation: Use bounded, static Python source with numpy, pandas and scipy because limma and sva are not promised installed. Implement the documented equations directly, including digamma/trigamma inversion for limma variance moderation and stable Student-t survival probabilities. This is a numerical implementation of the requested methods, not a substitution with unmoderated OLS or a generic batch-correction method. Verify core identities on deterministic constructed examples before the real-data run. Do not invent a published numeric target or register a reproduction claim.

preferred_pipeline.model: Use the step-1 quantile-normalised values without ComBat. Fit all retained independent samples and all observed condition levels in a single additive model with condition indicators and batch fixed effects. Use rank-revealing linear algebra, an explicit estimability check and an equivalent full-rank parameterisation if needed; do not let a reference-level choice change the contrast. Test C10 minus C15 using the same limma-equivalent default variance moderation and BH family as in the prior pipeline. This estimates a common condition contrast conditional on batch; it assumes an additive batch effect and independent retained sample profiles.
preferred_pipeline.feature_family: All source feature rows; feature names remain distinct even when profiles coincide. No p-value-dependent filtering. If a feature cannot be tested, preserve it in the family with p=1 for BH counting, record why, and keep its numerical estimate unavailable rather than zero.
preferred_pipeline.sensitivity: Also calculate QN-only condition-model results, target-only batch-adjusted-in-model results when estimable, and target-only within-shared-batch results when available. Retain every condition in the primary preferred model so the rerun and preferred result differ principally in handling batch. Examine effect estimates, unscaled contrast standard errors, residual variances and degrees of freedom to distinguish effect amplification from false precision. Perform leave-one-batch and leave-one-target-sample analyses where estimable as diagnostics; do not select the preferred model by its discovery count.

scalar_primary.meaning: The scalar is the average squared true conditional expression difference over measured probes. It measures the transcriptome-wide magnitude, remains meaningful with opposite directions across probes, and is not a substitute discovery count, an arbitrary selected feature, a mean signed shift erased by quantile normalisation, or a dummy estimate. The MEI 0.069183 log2-squared is approximately log2(1.2)^2, corresponding to a 20-percent root-mean-square multiplicative difference across the assayed transcriptome; report it as a practical magnitude benchmark, not a feature-selection threshold.
scalar_primary.estimate: For the preferred design compute ordinary least-squares contrasts beta_g and their unmoderated sampling variances v_g. Report U = mean_g(beta_g^2 - v_g) over all estimable features. U is a noise-corrected estimator of mean squared effect and may be negative due to sampling error; retain its signed value in primary.json. Report sqrt(max(U,0)) as a supplementary magnitude only, not as a substitute primary estimate. Report the estimable feature denominator explicitly.
scalar_primary.bootstrap: Use B=1999 independent sample-level Rademacher wild-bootstrap draws, numpy random generator seed 20261013. For uncertainty, use full-model fitted values plus full-model residuals divided by sqrt(1-h_ii) times one shared draw per sample across every feature, preserving cross-feature dependence. In each draw refit the same fixed design and recompute U including the sampling-variance subtraction. Compute se as the sample standard deviation of bootstrap U and a two-sided 95-percent basic bootstrap interval using the 2.5th and 97.5th quantiles of Ustar-U. Vectorise contrast projection and residual-sum-of-squares calculations; no feature-by-feature process spawning. Rows with leverage numerically equal to one have zero identifiable residual and contribute zero bootstrap residual; report their number and the resulting limitation.
scalar_primary.test: For the directional global null, fit the reduced preferred model imposing equal C10 and C15 coefficients while preserving other conditions and batch. Generate a separate B=1999 wild-bootstrap series from its fitted values and leverage-corrected residuals. Refit the unrestricted preferred model and recompute U for each draw. The greater-tail p-value is (1 + number of Ustar_null >= U_observed)/(B+1). This exploratory test uses samples as resampling units and preserves correlations among probe outcomes. Do not claim that the bootstrap or matrix join is certified by a registered design.
scalar_primary.v7: Write outputs/primary.json using the host V7 envelope for c10_c15_transcriptome_effect with the actual scalar U estimate, actual bootstrap se and actual directional p, plus its interval and explicit exploratory status wherever the envelope permits. Put detailed feature-wise results in an artifact and all task answers in task-results.json. No fabricated scalar, replacement integrity claim, or artifact path in a required numeric field. If a host envelope demands registered certification, report unsupported certification rather than changing the estimand.

attribution_and_verdict.verdict: Freeze a majority-retention interpretation of the otherwise unquantified word extensive. Set holds-up only if reproduced_count is positive, final_count is at least half of reproduced_count, at least half of the prior discoveries are also final discoveries with the same estimated sign, and the exploratory global test has p<0.05 with its 95-percent effect interval lower endpoint greater than zero. Otherwise set does-not-hold-up, describing this as failure to substantiate the extent, not proof of no biological difference. Report the count ratio, overlap, sign agreement, global estimate and uncertainty; disclose that the majority threshold operationalises qualitative wording and is not a supplied published target. The MEI describes practical effect magnitude separately and does not change the user's q<0.05 counts.
attribution_and_verdict.cause: Attribute cause using prespecified computational comparisons, not the expected story. On the same retained units compute (A) QN plus condition only, (B) QN plus parametric ComBat plus condition only, (C) QN plus condition and batch, and (D) QN plus ComBat plus condition and batch as a diagnostic. Compare counts, effect sizes and standard-error changes to the preferred model. A large count appearing after ComBat that is absent with direct batch modelling supports batch-adjustment-step, including ignored uncertainty and induced sample dependence. Inflation already present in the QN condition-only model and resolved by directly modelling batch, without evidence of an added ComBat-specific increase, supports linear-model-step. multiple-testing-step requires an actual discrepancy between the specified BH calculation and the counted discoveries; it cannot be inferred from many small p-values. Mislabelled-samples requires independently established annotation contradictions, and outlier-samples requires a documented technical failure plus decisive influence, not unusual expression alone. Quantify any verified sample-problem count changes before preferring a sample-based cause. Use true-difference when the extent survives the preferred analysis and no verified artifact dominates. Report competing explanations and limitations in methods rather than claiming mechanistic certainty from one count.

outputs.task_results: Write outputs/task-results.json containing every requested field: verdict, cause, reproduced_count, reproduced_top_features, final_count, final_batch_handling, design.first_condition_batches, design.second_condition_batches, data_integrity.duplicated_units, data_integrity.other_problems, data_integrity.units_of_analysis, and methods. Counts are JSON numbers computed from strict BH q<0.05; batch and identifier lists contain distinct served tokens. Batch lists come directly from all source sample-sheet rows of the relevant condition. Empty findings are empty arrays, never invented IDs.
outputs.report: Write outputs/report.json as the same single report object, fulfilling the requested report filename within the permitted outputs directory. Do not write a result file at the workspace root when runtime writes are limited to outputs and tmp.
outputs.evidence: Write feature-level tables for the prior and preferred models with feature, log2 contrast, standard error, moderated t, degrees of freedom, raw p and BH q; also save integrity/design diagnostics, sensitivity counts, global bootstrap summary and a concise methods/verdict explanation. Counts, rankings, batch lists and integrity findings are frozen computed task outputs, not artificial scientific claims.

sharedKnobs.execution_constraints: At implementation time supply run_all.sh, run_primary.sh and bounded static source under code. Launch Python directly from shell; use only installed numpy, pandas, scipy or statsmodels and standard-library parsing/serialization. No network, package installation, subprocess, eval, dynamic imports, dynamic execution or package-version introspection. Read data only via permitted local readers. Read the host-locked plan without modifying it. Final writes only under outputs; temporary files only under tmp. Use a fixed finite iteration limit for numerical solvers and resampling; failure to converge must be reported, not concealed.

import json
import csv
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import linalg, special, optimize, stats


def write_json(name, obj):
    with open('outputs/' + name, 'w') as handle:
        json.dump(obj, handle, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        handle.write('\n')


def bh(p):
    order = np.argsort(p, kind='stable')
    q = np.empty(len(p))
    q[order] = np.minimum(1, np.minimum.accumulate(
        (p[order] * len(p) / np.arange(1, len(p) + 1))[::-1])[::-1])
    return q


def quantile_normalize(y):
    target = np.mean(np.sort(y, axis=0), axis=1)
    q = np.empty_like(y)
    grid = np.arange(len(y))
    for j in range(y.shape[1]):
        q[:, j] = np.interp(stats.rankdata(y[:, j], method='average') - 1,
                            grid, target)
    return q


def indicators(values):
    levels = sorted(set(values))
    return np.column_stack([values == v for v in levels]).astype(float), levels


def design(meta, batch=True, reduced=False):
    labels = meta.condition.to_numpy().copy()
    if reduced:
        labels[labels == 'C15'] = 'C10'
    x, levels = indicators(labels)
    c = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    if not reduced:
        if 'C10' not in levels or 'C15' not in levels:
            raise ValueError('Both target conditions are required')
        c[levels.index('C10')] = 1
        c[levels.index('C15')] = -1
    if batch:
        z, _ = indicators(meta.batch.to_numpy())
        x = np.column_stack((x, z[:, 1:]))
        c = np.r_[c, np.zeros(z.shape[1] - 1)]
    return x, c


def geometry(x, c):
    u, s, vt = linalg.svd(x, full_matrices=False)
    keep = s > max(x.shape) * np.finfo(float).eps * s[0]
    u, s, vt = u[:, keep], s[keep], vt[keep]
    projected = vt.T @ (vt @ c)
    if not np.allclose(projected, c, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8):
        raise ValueError('C10-minus-C15 contrast is not estimable')
    df = x.shape[0] - len(s)
    if df <= 0:
        raise ValueError('No residual degrees of freedom')
    a = u @ ((vt @ c) / s)
    return {'u': u, 'a': a, 'k': float(a @ a), 'df': int(df),
            'rank': int(len(s)), 'h': np.sum(u * u, axis=1)}


def variance_prior(s2, df):
    # limma fitFDist, equal residual df, no trend and no robust fitting.
    good = np.isfinite(s2) & (s2 >= 0)
    v = s2[good].copy()
    if len(v) < 2:
        raise ValueError('Insufficient residual variances for moderation')
    med = float(np.median(v))
    if med == 0:
        med = 1.0
    v = np.maximum(v, 1e-5 * med)
    e = np.log(v) - special.digamma(df / 2) + np.log(df / 2)
    ev = float(np.var(e, ddof=1) - special.polygamma(1, df / 2))
    if ev <= 0:
        return float('inf'), float(np.mean(v))
    root = optimize.brentq(lambda z: special.polygamma(1, z) - ev,
                           1e-10, max(1e10, 2 / ev), maxiter=200)
    d0 = 2 * root
    scale = float(np.exp(np.mean(e) + special.digamma(root) - np.log(root)))
    return float(d0), scale


def fit(y, meta, batch=True):
    x, c = design(meta, batch)
    geo = geometry(x, c)
    resid = y - (y @ geo['u']) @ geo['u'].T
    s2 = np.sum(resid * resid, axis=1) / geo['df']
    beta = y @ geo['a']
    d0, scale = variance_prior(s2, geo['df'])
    post = np.full(len(y), scale) if np.isinf(d0) else (
        geo['df'] * s2 + d0 * scale) / (geo['df'] + d0)
    totaldf = min(geo['df'] + d0, len(y) * geo['df'])
    se = np.sqrt(post * geo['k'])
    valid = np.isfinite(beta) & np.isfinite(se) & (se > 0)
    t = np.full(len(y), np.nan)
    t[valid] = beta[valid] / se[valid]
    p = np.ones(len(y))
    p[valid] = 2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(t[valid]), totaldf)
    return {'beta': beta, 's2': s2, 'se': se, 't': t, 'p': p,
            'q': bh(p), 'df_total': float(totaldf), 'prior_df': d0,
            'prior_scale': scale, 'geo': geo, 'valid': valid}


def combat(y, meta):
    batches = meta.batch.to_numpy()
    z, levels = indicators(batches)
    sizes = z.sum(axis=0)
    if np.any(sizes < 2):
        raise ValueError('A singleton batch prevents the prescribed location/scale ComBat')
    protected, _ = indicators(meta.condition.to_numpy())
    x = np.column_stack((z, protected[:, 1:]))
    if np.linalg.matrix_rank(x) != x.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError('Protected ComBat design is confounded; exact prior pipeline cannot run')
    excluded = np.zeros(len(y), dtype=bool)
    for level in levels:
        excluded |= np.var(y[:, batches == level], axis=1, ddof=1) == 0
    active = ~excluded
    data = y[active]
    if len(data) < 2:
        raise ValueError('Insufficient variable features for ComBat')
    coef = linalg.lstsq(x, data.T)[0]
    grand = (sizes / y.shape[1]) @ coef[:len(levels)]
    pooled = np.mean((data.T - x @ coef) ** 2, axis=0)
    if np.any(pooled <= 0):
        raise ValueError('Nonpositive ComBat pooled variance')
    standmean = grand[:, None] + (x[:, len(levels):] @ coef[len(levels):]).T
    standardized = (data - standmean) / np.sqrt(pooled[:, None])
    result = standardized.copy()
    iterations = {}
    for j, level in enumerate(levels):
        ix = batches == level
        sd = standardized[:, ix]
        gamma = np.mean(sd, axis=1)
        delta = np.var(sd, axis=1, ddof=1)
        gamma_bar = np.mean(gamma)
        tau2 = np.var(gamma, ddof=1)
        dm = np.mean(delta)
        dv = np.var(delta, ddof=1)
        if tau2 <= 0 or dv <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Degenerate ComBat empirical prior')
        aprior = (2 * dv + dm * dm) / dv
        bprior = (dm * dv + dm ** 3) / dv
        oldg, oldd = gamma.copy(), delta.copy()
        for iteration in range(10000):
            newg = (tau2 * sizes[j] * gamma + oldd * gamma_bar) / (tau2 * sizes[j] + oldd)
            ss = np.sum((sd - newg[:, None]) ** 2, axis=1)
            newd = (0.5 * ss + bprior) / (sizes[j] / 2 + aprior - 1)
            change = max(np.max(np.abs(newg - oldg) / np.maximum(np.abs(oldg), 1e-300)),
                         np.max(np.abs(newd - oldd) / np.maximum(np.abs(oldd), 1e-300)))
            oldg, oldd = newg, newd
            if change < 1e-4:
                break
        else:
            raise ValueError('ComBat failed to converge')
        result[:, ix] = (sd - newg[:, None]) / np.sqrt(newd[:, None])
        iterations[level] = iteration + 1
    adjusted = y.copy()
    adjusted[active] = result * np.sqrt(pooled[:, None]) + standmean
    return adjusted, {'unchanged_zero_within_batch_features': int(excluded.sum()),
                      'iterations': iterations, 'design_rank': int(x.shape[1])}


def bootstrap_quadratic(y, fit_geo, generator_geo, rng, count):
    # Exactly the planned wild refits, reduced to an n-by-n Gram quadratic.
    # This preserves every feature covariance without allocating B expression matrices.
    ug = generator_geo['u']
    fitted = (y @ ug) @ ug.T
    resid = y - fitted
    divisor = np.sqrt(np.maximum(1 - generator_geo['h'], 0))
    usable = divisor > 1e-7
    corrected = np.zeros_like(resid)
    corrected[:, usable] = resid[:, usable] / divisor[usable]
    a = fit_geo['a']
    b = fitted @ a
    gram = corrected.T @ corrected / len(y)
    r = np.eye(y.shape[1]) - fit_geo['u'] @ fit_geo['u'].T
    matrix = gram * np.outer(a, a) - fit_geo['k'] / fit_geo['df'] * gram * r
    cross = (b @ corrected) / len(y) * a
    weights = rng.choice(np.array([-1.0, 1.0]), size=(count, y.shape[1]))
    draws = np.mean(b * b) + 2 * weights @ cross + np.sum((weights @ matrix) * weights, axis=1)
    return draws, int((~usable).sum())


def global_effect(y, meta, model):
    valid = model['valid']
    y = y[valid]
    geo = model['geo']
    estimate = float(np.mean(model['beta'][valid] ** 2 - model['s2'][valid] * geo['k']))
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261013)
    boot, full_h1 = bootstrap_quadratic(y, geo, geo, rng, 1999)
    xr, cr = design(meta, batch=True, reduced=True)
    reduced_geo = geometry(xr, cr)
    null, null_h1 = bootstrap_quadratic(y, geo, reduced_geo, rng, 1999)
    se = float(np.std(boot, ddof=1))
    lo, hi = np.quantile(boot - estimate, [0.025, 0.975])
    interval = [float(estimate - hi), float(estimate - lo)]
    p = float((1 + np.count_nonzero(null >= estimate)) / 2000)
    return {'estimate': estimate, 'se': se, 'p': p, 'n_units': int(y.shape[1])}, {
        'status': 'exploratory; matrix join and mean squared effect are not a registered design',
        'outcome_join': 'A-samples.tsv sample joins expression matrix headers; feature rows are correlated outcomes',
        'interval_method': '1999 sample-level HC2 Rademacher wild refits; two-sided 95% basic interval',
        'wild_bootstrap_ci': interval, 'bootstrap_replicates': 1999, 'seed': 20261013,
        'null_test_method': 'restricted-model wild bootstrap, greater tail, plus-one correction',
        'full_model_leverage_one_units': full_h1, 'null_model_leverage_one_units': null_h1,
        'estimable_features': int(len(y)), 'rms_log2_effect': float(np.sqrt(max(estimate, 0))),
        'mei_mean_squared_log2': 0.069183,
        'bootstrap_mean': float(np.mean(boot)), 'null_quantiles': np.quantile(null, [0.025, 0.5, 0.975]).tolist()
    }


def summary(model):
    return {'count': int(np.count_nonzero(model['q'] < .05)),
            'rank': model['geo']['rank'], 'residual_df': model['geo']['df'],
            'unscaled_contrast_se': float(np.sqrt(model['geo']['k'])),
            'median_residual_variance': float(np.median(model['s2'])),
            'median_moderated_se': float(np.median(model['se'])),
            'rms_contrast': float(np.sqrt(np.mean(model['beta'] ** 2))),
            'prior_df': None if np.isinf(model['prior_df']) else model['prior_df'],
            'prior_scale': model['prior_scale'], 'total_df': model['df_total'],
            'untestable_features': int((~model['valid']).sum())}


def feature_table(name, features, model):
    pd.DataFrame({'feature': features, 'log2_contrast': model['beta'],
                  'standard_error': model['se'], 'moderated_t': model['t'],
                  'degrees_of_freedom': model['df_total'], 'p': model['p'],
                  'BH_q': model['q'], 'ordinary_residual_variance': model['s2']}).to_csv(
                      'outputs/' + name, sep='\t', index=False)


def registry(path, identifiers):
    tab = pd.read_csv(path, sep='\t', dtype=str, keep_default_na=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE)
    mappings = {}
    for _, row in tab.iterrows():
        decoded = {key: json.loads(row[key]) for key in ['original', 'canonical', 'target']}
        for val in decoded.values():
            if val in mappings and mappings[val] != decoded['canonical']:
                raise ValueError('Ambiguous alias registry mapping')
            mappings[val] = decoded['canonical']
    if not set(identifiers).issubset(mappings):
        raise ValueError('Registry does not cover source identifiers')
    return [mappings[val] for val in identifiers]


def identity_groups(raw, samples, canonical):
    parent = list(range(len(samples)))
    def root(i):
        for _ in range(len(samples)):
            if parent[i] == i:
                return i
            i = parent[i]
        raise ValueError('Identity-group cycle')
    for j in range(len(samples)):
        for k in range(j):
            if canonical[j] == canonical[k] or np.array_equal(raw[:, j], raw[:, k]):
                parent[root(j)] = root(k)
    groups = {}
    for j in range(len(samples)):
        groups.setdefault(root(j), []).append(j)
    return list(groups.values())


def collapse(y, meta, groups):
    cols, rows, conflicting = [], [], []
    for group in groups:
        m = meta.iloc[group]
        if m.batch.nunique() != 1 or m.condition.nunique() != 1:
            conflicting.extend(m['sample'].tolist())
            continue
        cols.append(np.mean(y[:, group], axis=1))
        rows.append(m.iloc[0])
    return np.column_stack(cols), pd.DataFrame(rows).reset_index(drop=True), conflicting


def profile_diagnostics(raw, qn, samples, meta):
    for name, matrix in [('raw', raw), ('quantile', qn)]:
        corr = np.corrcoef(matrix.T)
        pd.DataFrame(corr, index=samples, columns=samples).to_csv(
            'outputs/' + name + '-sample-correlations.tsv', sep='\t')
        gram = matrix.T @ matrix / len(matrix)
        dist2 = np.maximum(np.diag(gram)[:, None] + np.diag(gram)[None, :] - 2 * gram, 0)
        pd.DataFrame(np.sqrt(dist2), index=samples, columns=samples).to_csv(
            'outputs/' + name + '-sample-rms-distances.tsv', sep='\t')
    centered = qn - qn.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    vals, vec = linalg.eigh(centered.T @ centered)
    order = np.argsort(vals)[::-1][:5]
    scores = vec[:, order] * np.sqrt(np.maximum(vals[order], 0))
    table = meta.copy()
    for j in range(len(order)):
        table['PC' + str(j + 1)] = scores[:, j]
    for name, matrix in [('raw', raw), ('quantile', qn)]:
        for quant in [0, .25, .5, .75, 1]:
            table[name + '_q' + str(quant)] = np.quantile(matrix, quant, axis=0)
    table.to_csv('outputs/sample-diagnostics.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
    unusual = []
    distances = np.sqrt(np.sum(scores * scores, axis=1))
    med = np.median(distances)
    mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(distances - med))
    if mad > 0:
        for i in np.flatnonzero(distances > med + 6 * mad):
            unusual.append('Unusual PCA profile for ' + samples[i] + '; not proof of technical failure; retained')
    return unusual


def sensitivity_fit(y, meta):
    try:
        return summary(fit(y, meta, batch=True))
    except ValueError as err:
        return {'unavailable': str(err)}


def self_checks():
    assert np.allclose(bh(np.array([.01, .04, .03, .8])), [.04, .0533333333333333, .0533333333333333, .8])
    a = np.array([[1., 4.], [2., 1.], [3., 2.]])
    expected = np.array([[1., 3.5], [2., 1.], [3.5, 2.]])
    assert np.allclose(quantile_normalize(a), expected)
    meta = pd.DataFrame({'condition': ['C10', 'C15'] * 6,
                         'batch': ['b1'] * 6 + ['b2'] * 6})
    rng = np.random.default_rng(914)
    y = rng.normal(size=(70, 12))
    x, c = design(meta)
    g = geometry(x, c)
    beta = y @ g['a']
    assert np.allclose(beta, (np.linalg.lstsq(x, y.T, rcond=None)[0].T @ c))
    gen = np.random.default_rng(456)
    draws, _ = bootstrap_quadratic(y, g, g, gen, 8)
    gen = np.random.default_rng(456)
    w = gen.choice(np.array([-1., 1.]), size=(8, 12))
    fitted = (y @ g['u']) @ g['u'].T
    e = (y - fitted) / np.sqrt(1 - g['h'])
    direct = []
    for weights in w:
        ys = fitted + e * weights
        residual = ys - (ys @ g['u']) @ g['u'].T
        direct.append(np.mean((ys @ g['a']) ** 2 - g['k'] * np.sum(residual ** 2, axis=1) / g['df']))
    assert np.allclose(draws, direct, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10)
    xr, cr = design(meta, reduced=True)
    gr = geometry(xr, cr)
    null_draws, _ = bootstrap_quadratic(y, g, gr, np.random.default_rng(456), 8)
    fitted_null = (y @ gr['u']) @ gr['u'].T
    en = (y - fitted_null) / np.sqrt(1 - gr['h'])
    direct_null = []
    for weights in w:
        ys = fitted_null + en * weights
        residual = ys - (ys @ g['u']) @ g['u'].T
        direct_null.append(np.mean((ys @ g['a']) ** 2 - g['k'] * np.sum(residual ** 2, axis=1) / g['df']))
    assert np.allclose(null_draws, direct_null, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10)
    model = fit(y, meta)
    assert np.allclose(model['beta'], beta)
    assert np.allclose(model['p'], 2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(model['t']), model['df_total']))
    # Orthogonal batch coding and invariance to sample ordering.
    adj, _ = combat(y, meta)
    perm = np.arange(12)[::-1]
    adj2, _ = combat(y[:, perm], meta.iloc[perm].reset_index(drop=True))
    assert np.allclose(adj[:, perm], adj2, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8)


def main():
    Path('outputs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    Path('tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with open('plan.json') as handle:
        plan = json.load(handle)
    claim_id = plan['claims'][0]['id']
    self_checks()
    print('Numerical identity checks passed', flush=True)
    with open('data/A-expression.tsv') as handle:
        header = next(csv.reader(handle, delimiter='\t'))
    if header[0] != 'feature' or len(header) != len(set(header)):
        raise ValueError('Missing feature column or duplicated raw expression headers')
    frame = pd.read_csv('data/A-expression.tsv', sep='\t')
    meta = pd.read_csv('data/A-samples.tsv', sep='\t', dtype=str)
    features = frame['feature'].astype(str).to_numpy()
    samples = list(frame.columns[1:])
    if frame['feature'].isna().any() or len(set(features)) != len(features):
        raise ValueError('Missing or duplicated feature identifiers')
    if meta[['sample', 'batch', 'condition']].isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError('Missing sample annotation')
    if meta['sample'].duplicated().any() or set(samples) != set(meta['sample']):
        raise ValueError('Sample identities are not one-to-one')
    meta = meta.set_index('sample').loc[samples].reset_index()
    raw = frame.iloc[:, 1:].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    if raw.shape != tuple(plan['sharedKnobs']['source_metadata']['expression_shape']):
        raise ValueError('Matrix shape differs from locked contract')
    if not np.isfinite(raw).all():
        raise ValueError('Nonfinite expression values')
    registry('data/probe-aliases.tsv', features)
    canonical = registry('data/sample-aliases.tsv', samples)
    groups = identity_groups(raw, samples, canonical)
    duplicates = sorted({samples[j] for group in groups if len(group) > 1 for j in group})
    qn = quantile_normalize(raw)
    np.save('tmp/quantile-normalized.npy', qn)
    problems = profile_diagnostics(raw, qn, samples, meta)
    cross = pd.crosstab(meta.batch, meta.condition)
    cross.to_csv('outputs/batch-condition-table.tsv', sep='\t')
    first = sorted(meta.loc[meta.condition == 'C10', 'batch'].unique().tolist())
    second = sorted(meta.loc[meta.condition == 'C15', 'batch'].unique().tolist())
    print('Join, integrity and full-matrix normalisation complete', flush=True)
    adjusted, combat_info = combat(qn, meta)
    prior = fit(adjusted, meta, batch=False)
    final_y, final_meta, conflicting = collapse(qn, meta, groups)
    adj_y, adj_meta, _ = collapse(adjusted, meta, groups)
    if conflicting:
        problems.append('Conflicting annotations for confirmed duplicate units excluded: ' + ', '.join(conflicting))
    final = fit(final_y, final_meta, batch=True)
    a = fit(final_y, final_meta, batch=False)
    b = fit(adj_y, adj_meta, batch=False)
    d = fit(adj_y, adj_meta, batch=True)
    scalar, global_diag = global_effect(final_y, final_meta, final)
    print('Prior, preferred, ablation and global bootstrap computations complete', flush=True)
    sens = {'A_qn_condition': summary(a), 'B_combat_condition_retained': summary(b),
            'C_qn_condition_batch': summary(final), 'D_combat_condition_batch': summary(d),
            'prior_all_samples': summary(prior)}
    target = final_meta.condition.isin(['C10', 'C15']).to_numpy()
    shared = target & final_meta.batch.isin(set(first) & set(second)).to_numpy()
    sens['target_only'] = sensitivity_fit(final_y[:, target], final_meta.loc[target].reset_index(drop=True))
    if np.any(shared):
        sens['target_shared_batches'] = sensitivity_fit(final_y[:, shared], final_meta.loc[shared].reset_index(drop=True))
    else:
        sens['target_shared_batches'] = {'unavailable': 'No shared target-condition batches'}
    sens['leave_one_batch'] = {}
    for batch in sorted(final_meta.batch.unique()):
        keep = (final_meta.batch != batch).to_numpy()
        sens['leave_one_batch'][batch] = sensitivity_fit(final_y[:, keep], final_meta.loc[keep].reset_index(drop=True))
    print('Leave-one-batch diagnostics complete', flush=True)
    sens['leave_one_target_sample'] = {}
    for j in np.flatnonzero(target):
        keep = np.arange(len(final_meta)) != j
        sens['leave_one_target_sample'][str(final_meta.iloc[j]['sample'])] = sensitivity_fit(
            final_y[:, keep], final_meta.loc[keep].reset_index(drop=True))
    rc = summary(prior)['count']
    fc = summary(final)['count']
    prior_sig = prior['q'] < .05
    final_sig = final['q'] < .05
    overlap = int(np.count_nonzero(prior_sig & final_sig))
    agree = int(np.count_nonzero(prior_sig & final_sig & (np.sign(prior['beta']) == np.sign(final['beta']))))
    holds = rc > 0 and fc >= .5 * rc and agree >= .5 * rc and scalar['p'] < .05 and global_diag['wild_bootstrap_ci'][0] > 0
    # Operationalise the locked attribution through the added ComBat excess
    # versus the excess already present in condition-only QN testing.
    ac, bc = summary(a)['count'], summary(b)['count']
    added_excess = max(bc - max(ac, fc), 0)
    existing_excess = max(ac - fc, 0)
    median_se_ratio = float(np.median(b['se'] / final['se']))
    if holds:
        cause = 'true-difference'
    elif added_excess > existing_excess:
        cause = 'batch-adjustment-step'
    else:
        cause = 'linear-model-step'
    zero = int(np.count_nonzero(np.var(raw, axis=1) == 0))
    if zero:
        problems.append(str(zero) + ' constant raw feature rows')
    if combat_info['unchanged_zero_within_batch_features']:
        problems.append(str(combat_info['unchanged_zero_within_batch_features']) + ' features left unchanged by standard ComBat zero-within-batch-variance handling')
    if summary(final)['untestable_features']:
        problems.append(str(summary(final)['untestable_features']) + ' untestable features retained in BH family with p=1')
    order = np.lexsort((features, prior['p']))[:10]
    methods = (
        'Expression columns were joined to sample metadata by exact sample identifiers; alias JSON cells were decoded. '
        'All features and samples underwent one limma-style quantile normalisation, with average-rank interpolation for ties. '
        'The prior pipeline used all conditions in parametric location/scale ComBat and then a condition-only model. '
        'The preferred analysis used the same quantile-normalised values with all condition levels and batch fixed effects in one model. '
        'Both pipelines used C10 minus C15, limma-equivalent default non-robust, non-trended empirical-Bayes moderated t tests, '
        'and BH adjustment over every feature with strict q<0.05. No feature selection or expression-based sample exclusions were used. '
        'Confirmed duplicate identity groups were collapsed only in the preferred analysis; conflicting identity groups were excluded. '
        'The global mean squared effect subtracts ordinary sampling variance and uses 1999 sample-level HC2 wild-bootstrap draws '
        'for uncertainty and 1999 restricted-null draws for its greater-tail p-value. This matrix-join claim is exploratory and not '
        'a registered scalar-column test. Its basic bootstrap interval is reported as a diagnostic, not a software-certified interval. '
        'The locked verdict requires at least half the prior count and half the same-sign discoveries to survive, plus global p<0.05 '
        'and a positive lower confidence limit. This majority threshold operationalises extensive; no published numeric target was supplied. '
        'A failure of these requirements does not establish absence of biological differences. '
        'Probe correlations are preserved in global resampling; additive batch effects and independent retained sample profiles are assumed. '
        'Without subject identifiers or external labels, hidden overlap and mislabelling cannot be ruled out. '
        'The cause is based on count and precision ablations; clustering alone cannot establish mislabelling or technical failure. '
        'Comparisons of counts, effects, residual variances and contrast uncertainty are saved in diagnostics.json. '
        'Prior count=' + str(rc) + '; final count=' + str(fc) + '; same-sign overlap=' + str(agree) + '.'
    )
    report = {'verdict': 'holds-up' if holds else 'does-not-hold-up', 'cause': cause,
              'reproduced_count': rc, 'reproduced_top_features': features[order].tolist(),
              'final_count': fc, 'final_batch_handling': 'in-model',
              'design': {'first_condition_batches': first, 'second_condition_batches': second},
              'data_integrity': {'duplicated_units': duplicates, 'other_problems': problems,
                                 'units_of_analysis': 'Independent sample expression profiles; confirmed concordant duplicate identity groups collapsed in preferred analysis; correlated probe rows are outcomes, not replicates'},
              'methods': methods}
    diagnostics = {'global_effect': dict(global_diag, **scalar), 'models': sens, 'combat': combat_info,
                   'discovery_overlap': overlap, 'same_sign_discovery_overlap': agree,
                   'final_to_prior_count_ratio': fc / rc if rc else None,
                   'attribution': {'added_combat_count_excess': added_excess,
                                   'qn_condition_only_count_excess': existing_excess,
                                   'median_combat_to_in_model_se_ratio': median_se_ratio,
                                   'verified_sample_problem_prior_count_change': rc - bc,
                                   'limitations': 'Ablations distinguish stages but do not prove a unique biological or technical mechanism.'},
                   'integrity': {'source_shape': list(raw.shape), 'duplicate_groups': [[samples[j] for j in group] for group in groups if len(group) > 1],
                                 'excluded_conflicting_identity_units': conflicting, 'zero_variance_rows': zero,
                                 'retained_units': len(final_meta), 'all_values_finite': True,
                                 'input_order_used_only_for_alignment': True},
                   'numerical_identity_checks': 'passed'}
    # No ci here: there is no registered interval for the exploratory matrix join.
    write_json('primary.json', {'claims': {claim_id: scalar}, 'metadata': {
        claim_id: {'status': global_diag['status'], 'outcome_join': global_diag['outcome_join'],
                   'diagnostic_interval': 'outputs/diagnostics.json: global_effect.wild_bootstrap_ci',
                   'p_method': global_diag['null_test_method']}}})
    write_json('task-results.json', report)
    write_json('report.json', report)
    write_json('diagnostics.json', diagnostics)
    feature_table('prior-features.tsv', features, prior)
    feature_table('final-features.tsv', features, final)
    print('Complete: all task outputs and genuine scalar primary result written', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
